planned_arguments.prompt:
Edit the supplied own poster into one finished opaque landscape 16:9 poster. Retain the actual overhead horseshoe composition, complete adult neighbors seated on individual rectangular mats, central open floor, illuminated visible screen face at upper-right, and standing microphone-bearing director speaking with two listeners. Preserve the exact arrangement, coherent bodies and physical contacts, open lower ends, ochre/cobalt/warm-red palette, all ten copy entries once, their word spaces and punctuation, and their current five information group locations. No added copy, labels, numbers, logos, pseudo-print, QR or watermark. No contact sheet, panels or mockup.

Observed changes to make:
1. Establish the assigned DATE-led hierarchy. The current upper-left Korean title and English companion dominate the central date. Reduce the Korean identity to about 29–30 px at width 720, and its English companion to 18 px. Keep the upper-left identity aligned at x4%, outside the seating arc. Set the central date to 33 px and the time to 35 px at width 720; date and time should be the leading attendance decision surrounded by the gathering. Keep generous clear space around that central group. Scale these existing text entries, preserving them verbatim:
다리 아래 영화관
BRIDGE CINEMA
2026.12.05 토요일
18:00–20:30
Keep every other existing entry intact, horizontal, at least 17 px at width 720, with fully formed robust Korean sans, intact counters and word spaces. Maintain activity/venue upper-right and the aligned practical groups at the two lower ends. Do not shrink or sacrifice practical readability.

2. Resolve the overly detailed naturalistic scene into the assigned precise flat editorial drawing. Keep the SAME complete mat-and-body units and conversational gesture, but simplify paving, clothing, bags, mats and screen illustration to broad clean matte color shapes, minimal contour lines and restrained contact shadows. Remove the fine grain, scratches, photoreal ground detail, numerous tiny paving lines, clothing-fold shading and busy mat striping. Use sunny ochre as the continuous flat ground, deep cobalt for the main graphic bodies and frames, and limited warm red accents. A few sparse large paving joints and one broad muted ochre bridge-cast shadow are enough. Keep the outdoor-under-bridge setting recognizable. Do not convert complete adults into isolated glyphs, tiny icons, dots or a rigid grid. Make the bright screen face plain and clearly visible with a simple nonglyph cinematic image, stable frame/feet, no screen text. Keep the microphone in the director's hand and two listeners clearly oriented toward that person. Preserve the inviting adult civic-event tone.

Keep the broad connected horseshoe occupying the middle of the landscape sheet, central aisle about 40% wide, and all text zones free from objects. The finished result is one separate flat opaque poster, composition built for 16:9. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.
